question: Does PROPOSE offer only single cells, or also connected unions?

subjects.operative_offer: One incidence fibre, potentially containing multiple flags; not one flag only.
subjects.diagnostic_input: A two-site union field is a source state, not an additional offered enactment.
subjects.law_scope: The inspected clauses supply completions and gluing readings but do not specify closure of offered domains under connected union.

findings.subject: Bound implementation 019/020
findings.content: Offers are SITE, EDGE, TRIAD and overlap PAIR fibres, each uniformly THIS or NO. 019 constructs TWO_SITES as input fields; it does not derive R1_CASE from TWO_SITES. 020 imports R1_CASE into P20_OFFER.

findings.subject: All connected unions are offered
findings.content: Not supplied by the inspected constructions. A6 constrains strict-discharge terminals; it does not uniquely construct an all-connected-unions offer family. A4/sheaf assembly glues supplied witness projections, not a flag-union offer constructor.

findings.subject: Single fibres are the exclusive law-level domain for every future realization
findings.content: The bounded implementation does not establish that universal restriction. No exclusion of union offers is inferred from the finite 1,924-member domain.
